title: Buffon's Noodle: Axiom-Free Smooth Case via Concrete Integration
description: Eliminates the two axioms from BuffonsNoodle.lean by showing the smooth Buffon-Barbier theorem (E[crossings] = 2L/(πd)) is provable using the angular-average integration framework. The axiomatic smoothExpectedCrossings is replaced by the concrete double-integral definition concreteSmoothExpectedCrossings, and buffon_noodle_smooth_eq becomes a theorem via buffon_smooth_of_contDiff. All downstream results (shape independence, non-negativity, monotonicity) are re-derived axiom-free.

mathlibDependencies.description: Buffon-Barbier formula for C¹ curves (ContDiff ℝ 1 γ suffices)
Concrete double-integral definition of expected crossings

theorems.name: planarArcLength_eq
theorems.statement: planarArcLength γ a b = planarCurveArcLength γ a b
theorems.description: The two arc length definitions (from OQ01OQ01 and BuffonsNoodle) are equal by rfl

theorems.name: buffon_noodle_smooth_theorem
theorems.statement: ContDiff ℝ 1 γ → concreteSmoothExpectedCrossings γ a b d = 2 * planarCurveArcLength γ a b / (π * d)
theorems.description: The axiom buffon_noodle_smooth_eq, proved as a theorem

theorems.name: smooth_shape_independence_free
theorems.statement: Two C¹ curves with equal arc length have equal expected crossings

theorems.name: smooth_crossings_mono_free
theorems.statement: Longer C¹ curves have more expected crossings

theorems.name: straight_line_axiom_free
theorems.statement: concreteSmoothExpectedCrossings (fun t => (t, 0)) a b d = 2 * (b - a) / (π * d)
theorems.description: Consistency with original Buffon's Needle formula
